title: MZ Making Plugin active only while control input is pressed

posts.author: chris-cote
posts.body:
Hi folks,
I am using Galv's "Stationary Turn" plugin (
https://galvs-scripts.com/2016/07/01/mv-stationary-turn/
) in my MZ project via fossil. While the plugin works perfectly, it is only a benefit in some scenarios and a detriment in others.
I'd like to make it so that the "turn in place" effect only happens while the player is holding down the Ctrl key. The two issues I am having however are:
1.) I am not sure which part of this plugin to "wrap" in a condition without breaking it. And,
2.) I want to check for the keymapper input "control", not a specific keyboard key, so that it works with rebinding, gamepad (by binding a button to "control") and also with multiple control keys being present.
The plugin itself seems pretty basic, so hopefully this is not too hard to do.
Thanks!

Um… no? There's no such thing as a "screenshot shortcut" in RPGMaker as far as I know, and I even just checked in my MZ project to make sure. I'd assume you have some plugin that's adding that.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Yea, my guess would be either a plugin or another app on your system, like a snipping tool or the Steam overlay. If it works in a new project with no plugins, then it's almost certainly external.
(I think the practical reasoning behind WASD as opposed to arrow keys is ergonomics. Something about hand placement, strain of vertical vs horizontal movements, etc? Left-/right-handedness can also be important, e.g. if players want to move with keyboard but use mouse for menus.)

WASD is the industry standard, so for releasing a game on steam it is basically a must (as well as re-bindable controls), or else you'll get some negative reviews for it. When I had only directional keys (default), it was easily the #1 source of negative feedback. RPG Maker players are used to using arrow keys and Z/X, but most players don't like having to adjust to this control scheme. For this reason, my game uses both a WASD and arrow key layout by default. The game also has custom mouse support (which it is also hard to release to steam without), so WASD makes even more sense now. The game is a fairly standard farming/life sim in terms of controls.

UPDATE: It turned out to be SRD HUD Maker Ultra. Everything is working now that the screenshot parameter is disabled.
Thanks again for all the help!
